a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly ends with both of us at 0 cells, since reaching 8 takes at least 2 rounds. So I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than operate. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you so you can still reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. If we're still going, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take any more, so the reserve can get back to 4 for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
